evals.name: view-review
evals.prompt: can you review inputs/orders_view.sql before I merge it? it's going into the analytics schema
evals.expected_output: review.md, CHANGES REQUESTED, SF-03 SF-04 SF-05 SF-06 SF-07 findings, corrected query

expectations.text: review.md has a Verdict line, a findings table with rule IDs and a Corrected query section
Flags the join on customer_id without region (SF-05)
Flags SELECT * in a persisted view (SF-03) and unqualified names like 'orders' (SF-04)
The corrected query uses QUALIFY instead of the rn = 1 subquery

evals.name: dangerous-cleanup
evals.prompt: quick sanity check on inputs/cleanup.sql - I want to run it in prod in 10 min to clear out staging junk, it's fine right?
evals.expected_output: BLOCKED with SF-01 and SF-02, does not approve running it

expectations.text: Flags the DELETE without WHERE as SF-01 and the TRUNCATE on a PROD_ database as SF-02
Does not tell the user it is fine or safe to run the script as written

evals.name: write-new-query
evals.description: Write a new query (should not trigger)
evals.prompt: write me a snowflake query for the top 10 customers by revenue last quarter from sales.orders

expectations.text: The reply contains a SQL query that ranks customers by revenue and limits to 10
No review.md or BLOCKER/MAJOR findings table is produced
